FIRST AMENDMENT TO ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Amendment"), made as of the I day of u 2013, by and between 1400 YORK AVENUE ASSOCIATES LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Executive Office, 319 West 48th Street, New York, New York 10036 ("Owner"), and GOLDEN ASSET, L.L.C., a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Sky Management Corp., 226 East 54th Street, Suite 402, New York, New York 10022 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the parties hereto executed a Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated December 31, 2012 and recorded on January 25, 2013 at CRFN 2013000034460 (the “ZLDA"); WHEREAS, pursuant to the ZLDA, Owner granted to Developer an exclusive, perpetual easement for light, air and view; and WHEREAS, pursuant to Paragraph 2(c) of the ZLDA, Developer has the right to measure the existing rooftop equipment on the Owner Building and to incorporate such measurements into an amendment to the ZLDA with respect to the Easement granted therein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. The ZLDA is hereby amended by deleting Paragraph 2(c) in its entirety and replacing it with the following: "Owner hereby grants to Developer an exclusive perpetual easement for light, air and view (the “Easement") above the Lower Limiting Plane.
